svg.title: Current Sony interface — proposed DIP placement and pin reference
svg.desc: Provisional top view. U1 rows 1–4, U2 rows 6–12, K1 rows 14–17. Passives, sockets, mounting keepouts and jumpers are unplaced. Not a soldering map.
svg.text: Sony remote interface · proposed DIP placement
MCP41050 + HCT125 + LCC110 · TOP / COMPONENT VIEW
PROVISIONAL FIT STUDY — not a soldering or jumper map.
IC pin positions only. Actual bodies, sockets and mounting-hole keepouts still need a dry-fit.
All seven resistors, Q1, three capacitors and cable connections remain to be placed.
Dot = pin 1. All notches face the top of the image.
Body rectangles are symbols, not clearance envelopes.
Before soldering: check real board geometry, mounting holes, socket overlap and underside access.
Rows 5 and 13 are spacer rows. Side pads are already joined to the corresponding IC pin.
NC = leave unconnected; NC contact = unused normally-closed contact. No routing or fit is validated.
